draft.subject: Your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Jules,

Thanks again for the kickoff call last week. I know a first week can get busy, so I wanted to check in rather than let it drift.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one real project in is the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to work through your first project with you live.

Best,
Nadia
